name: Indian Infotech Preview editorial cache
description: Preview-only cache invalidation; does not deploy or modify content.

rule.filter: coalesce(after()._type, before()._type) in ["blogPost", "companyNews", "researchArticle", "author", "category", "testimonial"] && !(coalesce(after()._id, before()._id) in path("drafts.**")) && !(coalesce(after()._id, before()._id) in path("versions.**"))
rule.projection: {"projectId": "rmgfsayz", "dataset": "production", "_id": coalesce(after()._id, before()._id), "_type": coalesce(after()._type, before()._type), "operation": delta::operation(), "beforeSlug": before().slug.current, "afterSlug": after().slug.current}
